title.narrative: The Gambia's Responsive and Accountable Democratic Transition (EU-UNDP GREAT initiative)

description.narrative:
This project aims at strengthening and promoting democratic governance in The Gambia. The Specific objectives (outcomes) are threefold:


1.The Constitution and legislation better provide for checks and balances, protect human rights and fundamental freedoms including rights of minorities and groups living in vulnerable situations

2.Enhance effectiveness of transitional justice, rule of law and human rights mechanisms as per the transitional justice recommendations

3.Strengthen effectiveness of local governance structures and services

We are not able to disaggregate by age here as there is no choice available.We decided to report an accumulative target for end of 2025. The reason is that we will slowly reduce our support for legal aid interventions in 2025. As the project tries to implement sustainable structures in the legal aid sector it will reduce its amount of funding in 2025 substantially to test how sustainable the provision of legal aid in Zambia is. Therefore the numbers for 2025 wil be a lot lower then for the rest of the years. Thus we only report on an accumulative target.
